projects.title: Blockchain-Based Smart City Complaint System
projects.description: Built a full-stack decentralized complaint management system using React.js frontend, Node.js backend, and MongoDB, allowing citizens to submit city complaints online with real-time tracking. Integrated blockchain smart contracts to ensure data immutability, preventing tampering of complaint records. Designed a role-based complaint workflow for citizens and administrators, enabling complaint registration, status updates, and efficient grievance resolution through a user-friendly interface.

projects.title: URL Shortener with Analytics
projects.description: Developed a full-stack URL shortening platform using Spring Boot and React.js, enabling users to create, manage, and share shortened URLs with custom aliases. Implemented secure JWT-based authentication, RESTful APIs, and integrated MySQL with Spring Data JPA for efficient URL storage and management. Built features including click analytics, QR code generation, link expiration, and containerized the application using Docker for simplified deployment.
